introduction: Tennessee Community Action agencies serve specific counties. Use the association directory to find local intake rather than submitting one statewide emergency-aid application.
description: Tennessee Community Action agencies serve specific counties. Use the association directory to find local intake rather than submitting one statewide emergency-aid application.

sections.who: Eligibility and available programs depend on the local agency and funding source. Explain your actual need and county.
sections.get: Local agencies offer community services; the agency must confirm whether it currently provides the assistance you need.
sections.docs:
• County and contact information.
  • Income and household records requested locally.
  • Relevant bills or urgent notices.
sections.apply:
1. Find the county agency

    Use TACA’s service-area directory.

  2. Ask about current programs

    Describe the need and confirm openings, appointments and eligibility.

  3. Submit local records

    Follow the specific program checklist and save confirmation.
sections.after: Ask for alternative referrals if the agency cannot assist or funding is exhausted.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using TACA county providers. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The directory directs residents to agencies with defined county service areas.
Does every agency offer identical emergency help?
Confirm the current program directly with the county provider.
Can the directory help find a telephone number?
Yes. It lists provider contacts and service areas.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
